system.description: • Effect: Damage your Illusion spells deal to a creature that believes them is real: it can drop the creature to 0 HP, and spells that reduce their damage to believers (Shadow Monsters, Shadow Magic, Greater Shadow Magic) deal full damage. A creature that sees through the illusion takes none.

rules.value: Half-Real: your Illusion spells' damage to a creature that believes them is real (it can drop it to 0 HP and doesn't fade); half-damage illusions (Shadow Monsters) deal full.
